author: Steve Kuckuk
text: Perhaps a good lesson on what is a hypo and what is not… If it comes back on its own, then there really was no problem to begin with. Too often an alarm goes off and people treat . . . which sends the blood glucose sky high.

author: Janet Allen Fowler-Cox
text: Sometimes when I lose signal, either from pressure on it or leaving my phone in another room, it takes an hour or two to show a signal again. I wait it out awhile.
